source.dataset: NOAA ENC (public domain), the band 3 to 5 cells the wave 1 region files name, object LAKARE
source.method: every LAKARE area of the cells below, less any that meets a drying DEPARE (DRVAL1 below 0) of the cells (tidal water charted as a lake) and less any that meets a lakes.geojson polygon (Lake Union and Lake Washington keep their datum rule); the union cut to the owned zoom-10 tiles of all wave 1 regions less clip/canada-wa.geojson, split into polygons, holes filled, simplified (shapely) at 0.000010 degrees (about 1 m), coordinates rounded to 0.000001 degrees; each polygon named by the OBJNAMs of its LAKARE
